jobs.description:
ICT System Spezialist:in (m/w/d)

100%, Zürich, unbefristet

print
Drucken

Zur Unterstützung von Forschung und Lehre sind die Informatikdienste der ETH Zürich als Dienstleistungsorganisation in einer grossen und komplexen IT-Umgebung tätig. Wir bieten den Angehörigen der ETH Zürich hochwertige, flexible und skalierbare Informatik-Dienstleistungen an und unterstützen sie damit im Wettbewerb mit den besten Universitäten der Welt.

Die Sektion ID Customer Experience and Solutions (CxS) ist für den User-Support und das IT-Arbeitsplatzmanagement in Forschungsdepartementen, den zentralen administrativen Einheiten sowie bei ETH-nahen Einheiten zuständig. Zusätzlich verwaltet CxS die zentralen Computerarbeitsräume und betreibt die Multifunktionsdrucker an der ETH.

Stellenbeschreibung

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine erfahrene und engagierte Persönlichkeit als ICT System Spezialist:in (m/w/d)

Gestalten und Bewegen

In dieser vielseitigen Position bist du für die Planung, Weiterentwicklung und den reibungslosen Betrieb unserer heterogenen IT-Infrastruktur verantwortlich. Du schlägst die Brücke zwischen modernster Technik und exzellenter Forschung.

• System-Engineering: Du administrierst und optimierst unsere Client- Infrastruktur (Windows, Mac und Linux).

• Support & Infrastruktur: Du stellst den Betrieb der IT-Arbeitsplätze sicher und leistest kompetenten Support.

• Innovation durch Automatisierung: Mittels Scripting und moderner Tools automatisierst du Prozesse und entwickelst unsere IT-Services proaktiv weiter.

• Consulting: Du unterstützt und berätst Mitarbeitende der ZO bei allen IT-Fragen.

• Projekte: Neue Kundenanforderungen setzt du durch innovative Lösungen im Rahmen von Projekten um.

Profil

Fachverstand trifft Teamgeist

Du arbeitest gerne im Team und schätzt es strukturiert sowie dienstleistungsorientiert zu arbeiten. Bei komplexen Zusammenhängen behaltest du den Überblick und arbeitest dich leicht in neue Technologien ein. Du verfügst über die folgenden oder ähnlichen Kenntnisse:

• Fundament: Abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung oder ein Studium in einer technisch relevanten Fachrichtung.

• System-Know-how: Vertiefte Kenntnisse in der Administration von Windows Clients, sowie Erfahrung mit macOS, iOS, Linux-Knowhow

• Automatisierung: Praktische Erfahrung im Scripting (Bash, Python); Grundkenntnisse in PowerShell sind ein Plus.

• Kommunikation: Du schätzt den direkten Austausch mit Usern und kommunizierst sicher in Deutsch und Englisch.

• Weiterbildung: Du bringst die Bereitschaft mit, dich in dieser spannenden Funktion stetig weiterzubilden.

Du betreust unsere Kunden effizient sowie selbstständig und bringst dafür den Führerausweis Kat. B mit.

Hast du Freude daran, dein Wissen weiterzugeben und die ETH Zürich bei ihrem Grundauftrag, der Förderung von Bildung, Forschung und Innovation, zu unterstützen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Arbeitsort

Arbeitsort

Wir bieten

Dein Beruf mit Wirkung

Werde Teil der ETH Zürich, die nicht nur deine berufliche Entwicklung unterstützt, sondern auch aktiv zu positiven Veränderungen in der Gesellschaft beiträgt.

Arbeiten beim Vizepräsidium für Infrastruktur und Nachhaltigkeit (VPIN) bedeutet, die Zukunft der ETH Zürich aktiv mitzugestalten - eine inspirierende, internationale und innovative Institution. Dein Engagement schafft beste Voraussetzungen für Exzellenz in Lehre, Forschung, Wissenstransfer und Nachhaltigkeit der ETH Zürich.

In einer offenen, inspirierenden Atmosphäre bilden Vertrauen, Verlässlichkeit und gegenseitiger Respekt das Fundament unserer Zusammenarbeit. Wir bieten dir nicht nur Sicherheit, sondern auch vielfältige Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Bei uns erwartet dich eine sinn

descriptionByLocale.it:
Specialista del sistema ICT:in (m/f/d)

100%, Zurigo, perpetua

Stampato
Stampa

Per il supporto della ricerca e dell'insegnamento, i servizi IT di ETH Zürich sono tütig come organizzazione di servizio in un ambiente IT ampio e complesso. Offriamo servizi informatici di alta qualità, flessibili e scalabili a ETH Zürigen e supportarli in competizione con le migliori università del mondo.

La sezione ID Customer Experience and Solutions (CxS) è responsabile del supporto utente e della gestione del posto di lavoro IT nei reparti di ricerca, nelle unità amministrative centrali e nelle unità vicine a ETH. Inoltre, CxS gestisce il computer centrale e gestisce le stampanti multifunzione presso ETH.

Descrizione del lavoro

Per supportare il nostro team, stiamo cercando un individuo esperto e impegnato come specialista del sistema ICT: in (m/f/d)

Progettazione e movimento

In questa posizione versatile, sei responsabile della pianificazione, dell'ulteriore sviluppo e del buon funzionamento della nostra infrastruttura IT eterogenea. Hai spostato l'angolo tra tecnologia all'avanguardia e ricerca eccellente.

• System Engineering: gestisci e ottimizza l'infrastruttura client (Windows, Mac e Linux).

• Support & Infrastructure: Garantisci il funzionamento dell'IT-Arbeitsplä tze e fornire un supporto competente.

• Innovazione attraverso l'automazione: Utilizzando scripting e strumenti moderni, automatizzate i processi e sviluppate proattivamente i nostri servizi IT.

• Consulenza: Supporti e supporti i dipendenti ZO in tutti i problemi IT.

• Progetti: Realizzi nuovi requisiti dei clienti attraverso l'innovativo Lösung come parte di progetti.

Profilo

La competenza incontra lo spirito di squadra

Ti piace lavorare in un team e lavorare in modo strutturato e orientato al servizio. Quando si tratta di interazioni complesse, si tiene traccia e familiarizzare facilmente con le nuove tecnologie. Hai le seguenti conoscenze o simili:

• Fondazione: Formazione IT completata o una laurea in un settore tecnicomente rilevante.

• Know-how di sistema: conoscenza approfondita nell'amministrazione dei client Windows, nonché esperienza con macOS, iOS, Linux know-how

• Automazione: esperienza pratica nella scrittura (bash, pitone); conoscenza di base di PowerShell è un plus.

• Comunicazione: Si gode lo scambio diretto con gli utenti e comunicare in modo sicuro in tedesco e inglese.

• Ulteriore istruzione: Porti la volontà di formarsi continuamente in questa funzione emozionante.

Si prende cura dei nostri clienti in modo efficiente e te stesso e portare dafür la Führerausweis Cat. B.

Ti piace condividere le tue conoscenze e sostenere ETH Zürich nella sua missione di base, la promozione dell'istruzione, della ricerca e dell'innovazione? Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione!

Luogo di lavoro

Luogo di lavoro

Offriamo

La tua professione ha un impatto

Diventa parte di ETH Zürich, che non solo supporta lo sviluppo professionale, ma contribuisce attivamente ai cambiamenti positivi nella società.

Lavorare a Vizeprüsidium für Infrastructure and Sustainability (VPIN) significa plasmare attivamente il futuro di ETH Zürich – un'istituzione ispiratrice, internazionale e innovativa. Il vostro impegno crea le migliori condizioni per l'eccellenza nell'insegnamento, nella ricerca, nel trasferimento delle conoscenze e nella sostenibilità di ETH Zürich.

In un'atmosfera aperta, ispiratrice, fiducia, fedeltà e rispetto reciproco costituiscono la base della nostra cooperazione. Vi offriamo non solo la sicurezza, ma anche un sacco di opportunità di sviluppo. Con noi, un senso vi attende
descriptionByLocale.en:
ICT system specialist:in (m/f/d)

100%, Zurich, perpetual

Printed
Printing

For the support of research and teaching, the IT services of ETH Zürich are tütig as a service organization in a large and complex IT environment. We offer high-quality, flexible and scalable computer science services to ETH Zürigen and support them in competition with the best universities in the world.

The section ID Customer Experience and Solutions (CxS) is responsible for user support and IT workplace management in research departments, central administrative units and units close to ETH. In addition, CxS manages the central computer worker and operates the multifunction printers at ETH.

Job description

To support our team, we are looking for an experienced and committed individual as an ICT system specialist: in (m/f/d)

Designing and moving

In this versatile position, you are responsible for the planning, further development and smooth operation of our heterogeneous IT infrastructure. You slew the corner between state-of-the-art technology and excellent research.

• System Engineering: You manage and optimize our client infrastructure (Windows, Mac and Linux).

• Support & Infrastructure: You ensure the operation of the IT-Arbeitsplätze and provide competent support.

• Innovation through automation: Using scripting and modern tools, you automate processes and proactively develop our IT services.

• Consulting: You support and support ZO employees in all IT issues.

• Projects: You implement new customer requirements through innovative Lösung as part of projects.

Profile

Expertise meets team spirit

You like to work in a team and work in a structured and service-oriented way. When it comes to complex interactions, you keep track and easily familiarize yourself with new technologies. You have the following or similar knowledge:

• Foundation: Completed IT training or a degree in a technically relevant subject area.

• System know-how: In-depth knowledge in the administration of Windows clients, as well as experience with macOS, iOS, Linux know-how

• Automation: practical experience in scripting (bash, python); Basic knowledge of PowerShell is a plus.

• Communication: You enjoy the direct exchange with users and communicate safely in German and English.

• Further education: You bring the willingness to continuously train yourself in this exciting function.

You look after our customers efficiently and yourself and bring dafür the Führerausweis Cat. B.

Do you enjoy sharing your knowledge and supporting ETH Zürich in its basic mission, the promotion of education, research and innovation? We look forward to your application!

Place of work

Place of work

We offer

Your profession has an impact

Become part of ETH Zürich, which not only supports your professional development, but also actively contributes to positive changes in society.

Working at Vizeprüsidium für Infrastructure and Sustainability (VPIN) means actively shaping the future of ETH Zürich – an inspiring, international and innovative institution. Your commitment creates the best conditions for excellence in teaching, research, knowledge transfer and sustainability at ETH Zürich.

In an open, inspiring atmosphere, trust, loyalty and mutual respect form the foundation of our cooperation. We offer you not only security, but also plenty of development opportunities. With us, a sense awaits you

100%, Zurich, perpétuelle

Imprimé
Impression

Pour appuyer la recherche et l'enseignement, les services de TI de ETH Zürich sont tütig en tant qu'organisation de services dans un environnement informatique vaste et complexe. Nous offrons des services informatiques de haute qualité, flexibles et évolutives à ETH Zürigen et les soutenons en concurrence avec les meilleures universités du monde.

Pour soutenir notre équipe, nous recherchons une personne expérimentée et engagée en tant que spécialiste du système TIC: in (m/f/d)

Conception et déménagement

Dans cette position polyvalente, vous êtes responsable de la planification, du développement et du bon fonctionnement de notre infrastructure informatique hétérogène. Vous avez traversé le coin entre la technologie de pointe et l'excellente recherche.

• Ingénierie du système: Vous gérez et optimisez notre infrastructure client (Windows, Mac et Linux).

• Support & Infrastructure: Vous assurez le fonctionnement de l'informatique-Arbeitsplätze et fournir un soutien compétent.

• Innovation par l'automatisation : Grâce au script et aux outils modernes, vous automatisez les processus et développez de manière proactive nos services informatiques.

• Conseils : Vous soutenez et soutenez les employés de ZO dans tous les dossiers informatiques.

• Projets: Vous implémentez de nouvelles exigences client par le biais de Lösung innovants dans le cadre de projets.

Profil

L'expertise rencontre l'esprit d'équipe

Vous aimez travailler en équipe et travailler de manière structurée et axée sur le service. Quand il s'agit d'interactions complexes, vous gardez la trace et vous familiarisez facilement avec les nouvelles technologies. Vous avez les connaissances suivantes ou similaires:

• Fondation : Formation en TI ou diplôme dans un domaine techniquement pertinent.

• Savoir-faire système: Connaissance approfondie de l'administration des clients Windows, ainsi que de l'expérience avec macOS, iOS, savoir-faire Linux

• Automatisation: expérience pratique en script (bash, python); Connaissance de base de PowerShell est un plus.

• Communication: Vous appréciez l'échange direct avec les utilisateurs et communiquez en toute sécurité en allemand et en anglais.

• Enseignement complémentaire: Vous apportez la volonté de vous entraîner en permanence dans cette fonction passionnante.

Vous prenez soin de nos clients efficacement et vous-même et apportez dafür le Führerausweis Cat. B.

Vous aimez partager vos connaissances et soutenir l'ETH Zürich dans sa mission fondamentale, la promotion de l'éducation, de la recherche et de l'innovation? Nous nous réjouissons de votre candidature!

Lieu de travail

Lieu de travail

Nous offrons

Votre profession a un impact

Devenez membre de ETH Zürich, qui non seulement soutient votre perfectionnement professionnel, mais contribue également activement aux changements positifs dans la société.

Travailler à Viseprüsidium für Infrastructure and Sustainability (VPIN) signifie façonner activement l'avenir de l'ETH Zürich – une institution inspirante, internationale et innovante. Votre engagement crée les meilleures conditions d'excellence dans l'enseignement, la recherche, le transfert des connaissances et la durabilité à ETH Zürich.

Dans une atmosphère ouverte et inspirante, la confiance, la loyauté et le respect mutuel forment le fondement de notre coopération. Nous vous offrons non seulement la sécurité, mais aussi de nombreuses opportunités de développement. Avec nous, un sens vous attend

jobs.title: Platform Engineer (HPC & AI Infrastructure)

titleByLocale.en: Platform Engineer (HPC & AI Infrastructure)
titleByLocale.it: Ingegnere della piattaforma (HPC & AI Infrastructure)
titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur plate-forme (HPC et infrastructure AI)

jobs.description:
Platform Engineer (HPC & AI Infrastructure)

80%-100%, Zurich, permanent

print
Drucken

The High Performance Computing group at ETH Zurich provides world-class HPC and AI/ML infrastructure to researchers across all departments. We operate compute clusters with thousands of CPUs and GPUs, petabytes of storage, and high-speed, low-latency networks across multiple data centres in Switzerland.

As research workloads continue to evolve, we are building a hybrid and open platform that brings together traditional HPC and modern AI workloads.

We are looking for a Platform Engineer with a passion for Linux, automation, and open-source technologies to help us build and operate this infrastructure.

Job description

You will play a key role in automating and operating a large-scale, distributed computing platform. You will work with modern open-source technologies in a vendor-neutral ecosystem and contribute to building a highly reliable and efficient environment for scientific workloads.

What you will do

• Automate infrastructure provisioning and operational workflows using modern IaC tools

• Operate, troubleshoot, and improve Linux systems on both bare metal and virtual infrastructure

• Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines

• Build and operate on-premise cloud services based on Kubernetes

• Design and maintain observability platforms using metrics, logs, dashboards, and alerting systems

• Support core infrastructure services such as DNS, DHCP, and HTTP

• Troubleshoot networking issues involving TCP/IP, routing, and firewalls

• Occasional datacenter floor work (racking, cabling, bare-metal troubleshooting and repairs)

Profile

You are a curious and motivated engineer with a passion for automation and new technologies. You enjoy working collaboratively in a team while also being able to take ownership of tasks independently. Strong communication skills in English are essential, enabling you to work effectively in our international environment.

Required technical experience and skills

• Solid experience operating Linux systems in production environments

• Experience automating repetitive operational tasks

• Experience with shell scripting (Bash) and programming in at least one language such as Python, Go or Rust

• Familiarity with Kubernetes, Prometheus and Grafana

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Configuration Management (e.g. Cdist, Ansible, Terraform or similar)

• Basic understanding of TCP/IP networking, routing and firewalls

Nice to have

• Hands-on experience with HPC technologies such as InfiniBand networks and multi-GPU systems

• Experience deploying or operating Lustre or other parallel file systems

• Familiarity with Slurm, Spack, and scientific software environments

• Experience with hardware provisioning and out-of-band management technologies such as BMC, IPMI and Redfish

• German language skills

Workplace

Workplace

We offer

Your job with impact: become part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development but also actively contributes to positive change in society.

Working at the Vice Presidency for Infrastructure and Sustainability (VPIN) means helping to shape the future of ETH Zurich – an inspiring, international and innovative institution. Your commitment creates the best conditions for excellence in teaching, research, knowledge transfer and sustainability at ETH Zurich.

In an open, inspiring atmosphere, trust, reliability and mutual respect form the foundation of our collaboration. We offer not only security, but also diverse opportunities for development. With us, you can look forward to meaningful work in an innovative and appreciative environment – one that you can help shape and that opens new perspectives for you.

• Flexible working models with the option to partly work from home

• We live by the principle of Lifelong Learning .

• Benefits such as public transport subscriptions and car sharing, access to the wide range of ASVZ sports

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ingegnere della piattaforma (HPC & AI Infrastructure)

80%-100%, Zurigo, permanente

stampa
Druppo

Il gruppo High Performance Computing di ETH Zurich fornisce ai ricercatori di tutti i reparti un'infrastruttura HPC e AI/ML di livello mondiale. Utilizziamo cluster di calcolo con migliaia di CPU e GPU, petabyte di storage e reti ad alta velocità, a bassa latenza attraverso più data center in Svizzera.

Poiché i carichi di lavoro di ricerca continuano ad evolversi, stiamo costruendo una piattaforma ibrida e aperta che riunisce carichi di lavoro tradizionali HPC e AI moderni.

Stiamo cercando un Platform Engineer con una passione per Linux, automazione e tecnologie open source per aiutarci a costruire e gestire questa infrastruttura.

Descrizione del lavoro

Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nell'automazione e nel funzionamento di una piattaforma di calcolo di grandi dimensioni e distribuiti. Potrai lavorare con le moderne tecnologie open source in un ecosistema neutrale dei fornitori e contribuire a costruire un ambiente altamente affidabile ed efficiente per i carichi di lavoro scientifici.

Cosa farai

• Automatizzare il provisioning delle infrastrutture e i flussi di lavoro operativi utilizzando i moderni strumenti IaC

• Operare, risolvere i problemi e migliorare i sistemi Linux sia in metallo nudo che in infrastrutture virtuali

• Sviluppare e mantenere le tubazioni CI/CD

• Costruire e utilizzare i servizi cloud preconfezionati basati su Kubernetes

• Progettazione e manutenzione di piattaforme di osservabilità utilizzando metriche, registri, dashboard e sistemi di allerta

• Servizi di infrastruttura core di supporto come DNS, DHCP e HTTP

• Risoluzione problemi di rete che coinvolgono TCP/IP, routing e firewall

• Lavori occasionali di datacenter (racking, cablaggio, risoluzione dei problemi bare-metal e riparazioni)

Profilo

Sei un ingegnere curioso e motivato con una passione per l'automazione e le nuove tecnologie. Was du tun wirst

Sie sind ein neugieriger und motivierter Ingenieur mit einer Leidenschaft für Automatisierung und neue Technologien. Sie arbeiten gerne in einem Team zusammen und können Aufgaben unabhängig übernehmen. Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch sind unerlässlich, damit Sie in unserem internationalen Umfeld effektiv arbeiten können.

Erforderliche technische Erfahrung und Fähigkeiten

• Solide Erfahrung beim Betrieb von Linux-Systemen in Produktionsumgebungen

• Erfahrung in der Automatisierung von sich wiederholenden operativen Aufgaben

• Erfahrung mit Shell-Scripting (Bash) und Programmierung in mindestens einer Sprache wie Python, Go oder Rust

• Vertrautheit mit Kubernetes, Prometheus und Grafana

• Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code (IaC) und Configuration Management (z. B. Cdist, Ansible, Terraform oder ähnliches)

• Grundlegendes Verständnis von TCP/IP-Netzwerken, Routing und Firewalls

Nizza zu haben

• Praxiserfahrung mit HPC-Technologien wie InfiniBand-Netzwerken und Multi-GPU-Systemen

• Vertrautheit mit Slurm, Spack und wissenschaftlichen Softwareumgebungen

• Erfahrung mit Hardware-Provisioning und Out-of-Band-Management-Technologien wie BMC, IPMI und Redfish

• Deutsch Sprachkenntnisse

Arbeitsplatz

In der Vizepräsidentschaft Infrastruktur und Nachhaltigkeit (VPIN) zu arbeiten bedeutet, die Zukunft der ETH Zürich &ndash, einer inspirierenden, internationalen und innovativen Institution, mitzugestalten. In einer offenen, inspirierenden Atmosphäre bilden Vertrauen, Zuverlässigkeit und gegenseitiger Respekt die Grundlage unserer Zusammenarbeit. imprimer
Drucken

Le groupe de calcul haute performance de l'ETH Zurich fournit des infrastructures HPC et AI/ML de calibre mondial aux chercheurs de tous les départements. Description du poste

Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'automatisation et l'exploitation d'une plate-forme de calcul distribuée à grande échelle. Vous travaillerez avec des technologies open-source modernes dans un écosystème neutre des fournisseurs et contribuerez à la construction d'un environnement hautement fiable et efficace pour les charges de travail scientifiques.

Ce que vous ferez

• Automatiser la fourniture d'infrastructures et les flux de travail opérationnels à l'aide d'outils IaC modernes

• Fonctionnement, dépannage et amélioration des systèmes Linux sur le métal nu et l'infrastructure virtuelle

Expérience technique et compétences requises

• Solide expérience d'exploitation des systèmes Linux dans les environnements de production

• Expérience en automatisant les tâches opérationnelles répétitives

• Expérience avec le script shell (Bash) et la programmation dans au moins une langue comme Python, Go ou Rust

• Familiarité avec Kubernetes, Prométhée et Grafana

• Expérience de l'infrastructure en tant que code (IaC) et gestion de la configuration (p. ex., Cdist, Ansible, Terraform ou similaire)

• Connaissance de base du réseau TCP/IP, du routage et des pare-feu

Sympa d'avoir

• Expérience pratique des technologies HPC telles que les réseaux InfiniBand et les systèmes multi-GPU

• Expérience de déploiement ou d'exploitation de Lustre ou d'autres systèmes de fichiers parallèles

• Familiarité avec les environnements Slurm, Spack et logiciels scientifiques

• Expérience de la fourniture de matériel et des technologies de gestion hors bande telles que BMC, IPMI et Redfish

HR Business Partner:in Schulleitungsbereiche (m/w/d)

80%-100%, Zürich, unbefristet

print
Drucken

Die Abteilung HR Beratung ist beim Schulleitungsbereich des Vizepräsidiums für Personalentwicklung und Leadership (VPPL) angesiedelt und vereint die Bereiche HR Beratung Departemente und Schulleitungsbereiche, Berufsbildung, Case Management und Recruiting.

Als Teil des VPPL stehen wir für eine inklusive Kultur und Leadership ein, begegnen unseren Mitmenschen auf Augenhöhe, übernehmen gerne Verantwortung, denken und arbeiten vernetzt und haben eine Leidenschaft für innovative Ansätze – dies mit Mut und Leichtigkeit. Unsere Vision: Gemeinsam befähigen wir Menschen, das Potenzial ihrer selbst und anderer zu entfalten. Hier gelangst du zu einem kurzen Video-Interview mit unserer Vizepräsidentin Julia Dannath.

Für unser Team HR Beratung Schulleitung und Zentrale Organe suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine:n HR Business Partner:in Schulleitungsbereiche .

Stellenbeschreibung

• Als HR Business Partner:in bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson für zwei Schulleitungsbereiche und diverse Plattformen – von der strategischen Beratung bis zur operativen Umsetzung

• Du begleitest Führungskräfte proaktiv entlang des gesamten HR Lifecycle: Von Personalplanung und Rekrutierung von Senior Führungspositionen über Talent Management und Nachfolgeplanung bis hin zu Anstellungsbedingungen, Entlöhnung und Führungsentwicklung

• Ein Schwerpunkt deiner Arbeit liegt auf dem konsequenten und frühzeitigen Angehen und Begleiten von Leistungs- und Verhaltensthemen. Dabei bewegst du dich im Rahmen der Anstellungsbedingungen der ETH Zürich und des ETH Bereichs. Dies erfordert eine klare Prozesssteuerung, eine hohe Sorgfaltspflicht und Verhandlungsgeschick

• Du hast Freude daran, in diesem Rahmen wirksame, faire und nachhaltige Lösungen zu erarbeiten

• Du bist vertrauensvolle Anlaufstelle für Mitarbeitende bei persönlichen und arbeitsrechtlichen Fragen und wirst dabei von den zentralen HR Operations und Fachstellen (z.B. Case Management, Recruiting) unterstützt

• Im Zusammenspiel mit den Teams der Abteilungen Personalentwicklung und Leadership sowie Diversity und Kooperation gestaltest du eine beratungs- und entwicklungsorientierte Betreuung deiner Bereiche

• Du prägst eine konsequente und zeitgemässe Personalpolitik, bringst Projekte aktiv voran und arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit, ein modernes HR Management weiterzuentwickeln und umzusetzen

Profil

• Du bringst einen Hochschulabschluss respektive eine fundierte Grundausbildung sowie eine abgeschlossene Weiterbildung im HR Bereich mit und möchtest deine mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Funktion und ähnlich komplexen Organisation bei uns einbringen

• Du hast bereits bei personalstrategischen und -politischen Projekten in einer prägenden Rolle mitgewirkt

• Es begeistert dich, gute Beziehungen zu Vorgesetzten, Mitarbeitenden und Schnittstellen aufzubauen und zu pflegen sowie HR Themen professionell über alle Stufen hinweg weiterzuentwickeln

• Deine Position vertrittst du konsequent, mit Ausdauer und Feingefühl

• Du hast ein Flair für konzeptionelle sowie prozessorientierte Aufgaben und hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wann Beharrlichkeit und wann Pragmatismus gefragt ist

• Du schätzt ein Umfeld, das Wert auf Fairness, Mitbestimmung und Sorgfalt legt

• Mit Neugier und Engagement setzt du dich mit Digitalisierungstools und KI-Anwendungen auseinander und probierst diese Werkzeuge aus, um Innovationen aktiv zu fördern und gleichzeitig zur Unterstützung in vielen Themenbereichen beizutragen

• Du kommunizierst sicher und gewandt auf Deutsch und Englisch

• You will proactively accompany Führungskräfte along the entire HR lifecycle: From personnel planning and recruitment of senior Führungs positions üabout talent management and succession planning to employment conditions, entlöhnung and Führentwicklung

jobs.description:
Innovation Catalyst

60%-80%, Zurich, fixed-term

print
Drucken

At the ETH Student Project House (SPH) we inspire and empower students to cultivate a mindset of makers and innovators. We believe that by exploring their ideas and developing their own projects, students gain valuable hands-on experience and learn important skills for their future. This is why we’ve created an ecosystem where students (Bachelor, Master, and Doctoral students) are encouraged to explore, ideate, build prototypes, test and refine them.

Our interdisciplinary team of thirty people provides students who want to pursue extracurricular projects of various types and scales with a comprehensive range of support. On the one hand, we design and manage facilities like co-working, ideation, and event spaces as well as a makerspace that gives students access to the tools and equipment they need to prototype. On the other hand, we support project teams with personal coaching, workshops, and a diverse expert network. We want to accompany students on their journey by inspiring them to get started, to seek diverse views, to explore the real need behind an idea, to work as a team, to think big, to fail, to pivot, and to keep overcoming obstacles they encounter on the way.

We’re now looking for an Innovation Catalyst to join our team on a fixed-term maternity cover (for 5-6 months), with the possibility of extension.

Application Deadline: please apply before Friday, 17th of July, 9am.

Project background

You’ll work in one of the most inspiring spaces at ETH Zürich, surrounded by 3D-printers, whiteboards, ideation equipment, self-designed furniture, and plants.

• We’re located on the ETH Zentrum and ETH Hönggerberg campuses.

• We work in the same open space as our project teams and meet with everyone at eye level. The individuals we work with are from a diverse range of backgrounds and study disciplines, which is why we communicate in English.

• While a majority of our service offers run during the day, the projects we support are extracurricular, so most of our events and workshops take place in the late afternoon, sometimes in the evening, and occasionally on weekends.

• We take an agile approach to conceptualizing and delivering our offer and allocate our capacity flexibly to the most important tasks. Hereby, teamwork is one of our key values.

• You’ll be part of the project support subteam of 6 people that supports the “coached projects”. These projects are very diverse regarding topic, stage, intensity and goal. Some of them are entrepreneurial, others have another focus such as founding an NGO, a club, or participating a university competition. Currently we support more than 600 coached projects per year.

Job description

Together, we support the projects, in the fields of innovation and personal growth. In the role of an Innovation Catalyst, you are responsible for the following tasks:

• Coaching: You’ll coach early-stage projects from diverse backgrounds. You’ll help them to reflect, ask insightful questions, and support them to pin down their next steps, without taking on a leadership role.

• Conceptualizing and Managing: You’ll develop learning journeys and service offers to support our students from start to finish. This includes conceptualizing, testing, and building end-to-end processes, as well as documenting, running, continuously improving, and scaling these offers.

• Facilitating: You’ll facilitate workshops (e.g. ideation, need-finding), moderate expert training (e.g. business models, patents), or host peer-to-peer events.

• Driving: You'll lead key initiatives aligned with SPH's mission, including stakeholder management

In the Project Support team, we practice collegial management, sharing both leadership and accountability.

Profile

We need your energy and drive to support our projects, scale, and develop our offer to the next level.

• You have experience

descriptionByLocale.it: Innovazione Catalizzatore 60%-80%, Zurigo, a tempo determinato stampa Druppo Alla ETH Student Project House (SPH) ispiriamo e responsabilizziamo gli studenti a coltivare una mentalità di creatori e innovatori. Crediamo che esplorando le loro idee e sviluppando i propri progetti, gli studenti acquisiscono preziosa esperienza pratica e imparano competenze importanti per il loro futuro. Ecco perché abbiamo creato un ecosistema in cui gli studenti (Bachelor, Master e Dottorato) sono incoraggiati a esplorare, ideare, costruire prototipi, testarli e affinarli. Il nostro team interdisciplinare di trenta persone fornisce agli studenti che vogliono perseguire progetti extracurriculari di vari tipi e scale con una gamma completa di supporto. Da un lato, progettiamo e gestiamo strutture come la co-working, l'ideazione e gli spazi degli eventi, nonché uno spazio creatore che dà agli studenti l'accesso agli strumenti e alle attrezzature di cui hanno bisogno per prototipo. D'altra parte, supportiamo team di progetto con personal coaching, workshop e una rete esperta diversificata. Vogliamo accompagnare gli studenti nel loro viaggio ispirandoli a iniziare, a cercare opinioni diverse, ad esplorare il reale bisogno dietro un'idea, a lavorare come squadra, a pensare grande, a fallire, a pivot, e a mantenere gli ostacoli che incontrano sulla strada. Siamo ora alla ricerca di un Innovation Catalyst per unirsi al nostro team in una copertura premaman a tempo determinato (per 5-6 mesi), con la possibilità di estensione. Termine ultimo per l'applicazione: si prega di applicare prima di venerdì 17 luglio, 9. Sfondo del progetto Potrai lavorare in uno degli spazi più ispiranti di ETH Zürich, circondato da stampanti 3D, lavagne bianche, attrezzature per l'ideazione, mobili self-designed e piante. • Siamo situati nei campus ETH Zentrum e ETH Hönggerberg. • Lavoriamo nello stesso spazio aperto dei nostri team di progetto e ci incontriamo con tutti a livello degli occhi. Le persone con cui lavoriamo sono da una vasta gamma di sfondi e discipline di studio, motivo per cui comunichiamo in inglese. • Mentre la maggior parte delle nostre offerte di servizio si svolgono durante il giorno, i progetti che sosteniamo sono extracurriculari, quindi la maggior parte dei nostri eventi e workshop si svolgono nel tardo pomeriggio, a volte la sera, e occasionalmente nei fine settimana. • Prendiamo un approccio agile per concettualizzare e fornire la nostra offerta e allocare la nostra capacità in modo flessibile ai compiti più importanti. In questo modo, il lavoro di squadra è uno dei nostri valori chiave. • Sarete parte del sottoteam di supporto del progetto di 6 persone che supporta i “progetti accoppiati”. Questi progetti sono molto diversi per quanto riguarda argomento, stadio, intensità e obiettivo. Alcuni di loro sono imprenditoriali, altri hanno un altro focus come la fondazione di una ONG, un club, o la partecipazione di una competizione universitaria. Attualmente supportiamo più di 600 progetti istruiti all'anno. Descrizione del lavoro Insieme, sosteniamo i progetti, nei settori dell'innovazione e della crescita personale. Nel ruolo di Innovation Catalyst, sei responsabile dei seguenti compiti: • Coaching: Lei istruirà i progetti del primo stadio da diversi sfondi. Li aiuterai a riflettere, fare domande intuitive, e sostenerle a pin giù i loro passi successivi, senza assumere un ruolo di leadership. • Concettualizzazione e gestione: svilupperai viaggi di apprendimento e offerte di servizio per supportare i nostri studenti dall'inizio alla fine. Ciò include la concettualizzazione, il test e la costruzione di processi end-to-end, oltre a documentare, eseguire, migliorare continuamente e scalare queste offerte. • Facilitare: Facilitare i workshop (ad esempio l'ideazione, il bisogno-finanziamento), la formazione di esperti moderati (ad esempio modelli di business, brevetti), o gli eventi peer-to-peer ospitanti. • Guida: guiderai iniziative chiave allineate alla missione di SPH, inclusa la gestione degli stakeholder Nel team di Project Support, pratichiamo la gestione collegiale, condividendo sia la leadership che la responsabilità. Profilo Abbiamo bisogno della vostra energia e di guidare per sostenere i nostri progetti, scala e sviluppare la nostra offerta al livello successivo. • Hai esperienza

Dazu gehören das Konzipieren, Testen und Erstellen von End-to-End-Prozessen sowie das Dokumentieren, Ausführen, kontinuierliche Verbessern und Skalieren dieser Angebote. • Erleichterung: Sie bieten Workshops an (z. B. Ideation, Need-Finding), moderierte Expertenschulungen (z. B. Geschäftsmodelle, Patente) oder veranstalten Peer-to-Peer-Events. • Fahren: Sie leiten wichtige Initiativen, die auf die Mission von SPH ausgerichtet sind, einschließlich des Stakeholder-Managements Im Projekt-Support-Team üben wir kollegiales Management und teilen sowohl Führung als auch Rechenschaftspflicht. Profil Wir brauchen Ihre Energie und Ihren Antrieb, um unsere Projekte zu unterstützen, zu skalieren und unser Angebot auf die nächste Ebene zu entwickeln. • Sie haben Erfahrung
descriptionByLocale.fr: Catalyseur Innovation 60%-80%, Zurich, durée déterminée imprimer Drucken À l'ETH Student Project House (SPH), nous inspirons et autorisons les étudiants à cultiver un état d'esprit de décideurs et d'innovateurs. Nous croyons qu'en explorant leurs idées et en développant leurs propres projets, les étudiants acquièrent une expérience pratique précieuse et acquièrent des compétences importantes pour leur avenir. C'est pourquoi nous avons créé un écosystème où les étudiants (bachelor, master et doctorant) sont encouragés à explorer, à imaginer, à construire des prototypes, à les tester et à les affiner. Notre équipe interdisciplinaire de trente personnes fournit aux étudiants qui veulent poursuivre des projets extrascolaires de différents types et échelles avec une gamme complète de soutien. D'une part, nous concevons et gérons des installations telles que des espaces de coworking, d'idées et d'événements, ainsi qu'un espace fabricant qui donne aux étudiants l'accès aux outils et aux équipements dont ils ont besoin pour prototyper. D'autre part, nous soutenons des équipes de projet avec un encadrement personnel, des ateliers et un réseau d'experts diversifié. Nous voulons accompagner les étudiants dans leur voyage en les inspirant à commencer, à rechercher des vues diverses, à explorer le véritable besoin derrière une idée, à travailler en équipe, à penser grand, à échouer, à pivoter, et à continuer à surmonter les obstacles qu'ils rencontrent sur le chemin. Nous sommes maintenant à la recherche d'un Catalyst Innovation pour rejoindre notre équipe sur une couverture de maternité à durée déterminée (pour 5-6 mois), avec la possibilité d'extension. Date limite d'inscription: veuillez postuler avant le vendredi 17 juillet, 9h. Contexte du projet Vous travaillerez dans l'un des espaces les plus inspirants d'ETH Zürich, entouré par des imprimeurs 3D, des tableaux blancs, des équipements d'idées, des meubles auto-conçus et des plantes. • Nous sommes situés sur les campus ETH Zentrum et ETH Hönggerberg. • Nous travaillons dans le même espace ouvert que nos équipes de projet et nous rencontrons tous au niveau des yeux. Les personnes avec lesquelles nous travaillons proviennent d'un éventail varié de milieux et de disciplines d'études, c'est pourquoi nous communiquons en anglais. • Alors qu'une majorité de nos offres de services se déroulent pendant la journée, les projets que nous soutenons sont extrascolaires, de sorte que la plupart de nos événements et ateliers ont lieu en fin d'après-midi, parfois en soirée, et occasionnellement le week-end. • Nous adoptons une approche agile pour conceptualiser et livrer notre offre et affecter notre capacité avec souplesse aux tâches les plus importantes. Le travail d'équipe est l'une de nos valeurs clés. • Vous allez faire partie de la sous-équipe de soutien du projet de 6 personnes qui soutient les projets encochés. Ces projets sont très divers sur le sujet, l'étape, l'intensité et l'objectif. Certains d'entre eux sont des entrepreneurs, d'autres ont un autre objectif, comme fonder une ONG, un club ou participer à un concours universitaire. Actuellement, nous soutenons plus de 600 projets encadrés par année. Description du poste Ensemble, nous soutenons les projets, dans les domaines de l'innovation et de la croissance personnelle. Dans le rôle de catalyseur de l'innovation, vous êtes responsable des tâches suivantes: • Entraînement: Vous allez entraîner des projets en phase initiale de divers horizons. Vous les aiderez à réfléchir, à poser des questions perspicaces et à les soutenir dans leurs prochaines étapes, sans assumer un rôle de leadership. • Conceptualisation et gestion : Vous développerez des parcours d'apprentissage et des offres de services pour soutenir nos étudiants du début à la fin. Cela comprend la conceptualisation, l'essai et la construction de processus de bout en bout, ainsi que la documentation, le fonctionnement, l'amélioration continue et l'échelle de ces offres. • Faciliter : Vous faciliterez les ateliers (p. ex. idées, recherche des besoins), la formation d'experts modérés (p. ex. modèles d'affaires, brevets) ou l'organisation d'événements entre pairs. • Conduite : Vous dirigerez des initiatives clés alignées sur la mission de SPH, y compris la gestion des intervenants Au sein de l'équipe de soutien du projet, nous pratiquons la gestion collégiale, en partageant le leadership et la responsabilité. Profil Nous avons besoin de votre énergie et de votre énergie pour soutenir nos projets, l'échelle et développer notre offre au niveau suivant. • Vous avez de l'expérience

jobs.description:
Business Support mit Führungsunterstützung (m/w/d)

80%-100%, Zürich, unbefristet

print
Drucken

Wir in der Abteilung Sicherheit, Gesundheit und Umwelt (SGU) beraten, unterstützen und schulen sämtliche Organisationseinheiten und Angehörigen der ETH Zürich bei Fragen zu Sicherheit und Gesundheit am Arbeitsplatz. Wir sind Anlaufstelle für alle zentral zu organisierenden Massnahmen im Umgang mit Gefährdungen und Risiken zum Schutz von Mensch, Tier, Sachwerten, Infrastruktur und Umwelt sowie bei Fragen bezüglich der Erfüllung der entsprechenden gesetzlichen Anforderungen. Für den Ereignisfall unterhalten wir eine angemessene Notfallorganisation. Sowohl im Alltag als auch im Ereignisfall arbeiten wir eng mit den Behörden und externen Einsatzkräften zusammen.

SGU koordiniert sowohl im Alltag wie im Ereignisfall zahlreiche Projekte und Aufgaben. Dazu gehören beispielsweise das ETH-weite Travel Risk Management und Schadenmanagement, das Risikomanagement innerhalb des Vizepräsidiums für Infrastruktur und Nachhaltigkeit (VPIN) oder die Leitung diverser abteilungsübergreifender Gremien.

Um diese Aufgaben professionell und effizient erfüllen zu können, suchen wir als Führungsunterstützung ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte Persönlichkeit für Business Support, mit Flair für strategisches Projektmanagement (m/w/d).

Du hast Freude an der Bearbeitung von sicherheitsrelevanten Querschnittsaufgaben und Projekten? Interdisziplinäre Fragestellungen und das Koordinieren verschiedener Bedürfnisse und Zielgruppen sind für dich keine Last, sondern eine willkommene Herausforderung? Du liebst es, bestehende Organisationen und Prozesse stetig weiterzuentwickeln, komplexe Themen verständlich zu vermitteln und willst mit deinem Fachwissen und deiner Expertise wirklich etwas bewegen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit mit Begeisterung für Management und sicherheitsrelevante Themen sowie Interesse an Naturwissenschaft und Technik.

Stellenbeschreibung

Du möchtest die Zukunft von Safety, Security und Health an der ETH Zürich mitgestalten?

jobs.description:
PhD position in Modeling and Control of Nonlinear Dynamical Systems from Data

100%, Zurich, fixed-term

print
Drucken

The Chair in Nonlinear Dynamics at ETH Zürich is inviting applications for a 100% PhD position in the development and application of nonlinear dynamical systems methods for complex physical problems known only from data. The objective is to provide efficient, theoretically sound, fast, and directly interpretable alternative in modelling to the black-box approach of neural networks.

Job description

• The selected candidate will work on the furhter development of spectral submanifold (SSM) methods, aiming to further develop concepts in nonlinear model reduction

• Possible research directions include the development of nonlinear modelling and control approaches for fluid-structure interactions, material with memory, soft robotics, tele-operated systems, lightweight space structures, and turbulent flows

• Ongoing and prior work in related areas by the Chair in Nonlinear Dynamics can be found at the group website

• The position will be based at either the Department of Mechanical and Process Engineering or the Department of Mathematics, depending on the candidate’s background and preferences

• The starting date is flexible but an early start is preferred

Profile

• The successful candidate is expected to have a master's degree in mechanical engineering, applied mathematics, physics, or related areas

• Strong mathematical skills (evidenced by high grades) are required

• Prior research experience in problems related to fluid mechanics, structural vibrations, model reduction or control is expected

• Experience in nonlinear dynamical systems methods and data-driven analysis is a plus

Workplace

Workplace

We offer

• Your job with impact: Become part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development, but also actively contributes to positive change in society

• You can expect numerous benefits , such as public transport season tickets and car sharing, a wide range of sports offered by the ASVZ , childcare and attractive pension benefits

chevron_right
Working, teaching and research at ETH Zurich

We value diversity and sustainability

In line with our values , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future .

Curious? So are we.

We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

• A CV

• Bachelor and Master’s transcripts

• The contact information of at least two references

Further information about the group can be found the Chair of Nonlinear Dynamics website . Questions regarding the position should be directed to Prof. George Haller, georgehaller@ethz.ch (no applications).

Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

About ETH Zürich

ETH Zurich is one of the world’s leading universities specialising in
science and technology. We are renowned for our excellent education,
cutting-edge fundamental research and direct transfer of new knowledge
into society. Over 30,000 people from more than 120 countries find our
university to be a place that promotes independent thinking and an
environment that inspires excellence. Located in the heart of Europe,
yet forging connections all over the world, we work together to
develop solutions for the global challenges of today and tomorrow.

Stellenbeschreibung • Der ausgewählte Kandidat wird an der weiteren Entwicklung spektraler Submanifold-Methoden (SSM) arbeiten, um Konzepte zur nichtlinearen Modellreduktion weiterzuentwickeln. • Mögliche Forschungsrichtungen umfassen die Entwicklung nichtlinearer Modellierungs- und Steuerungsansätze für Fluid-Struktur-Wechselwirkungen, Material mit Speicher, weiche Robotik, teleoperierte Systeme, leichte Raumstrukturen und turbulente Strömungen. • Laufende und frühere Arbeiten in verwandten Bereichen durch den Lehrstuhl für Nichtlineare Dynamik finden Sie auf der Website der Gruppe • Die Position wird entweder in der Abteilung für Maschinenbau und Verfahrenstechnik oder in der Abteilung für Mathematik angesiedelt sein, abhängig vom Hintergrund und den Präferenzen des Kandidaten. • Das Startdatum ist flexibel, aber ein früher Start wird bevorzugt Profil • Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird erwartet, einen Master-Abschluss in Maschinenbau, angewandter Mathematik, Physik oder verwandten Bereichen zu haben • Starke mathematische Fähigkeiten (nachweist durch hohe Noten) sind erforderlich • Vorherige Forschungserfahrung in Problemen im Zusammenhang mit Fluidmechanik, Strukturschwingungen, Modellreduktion oder -steuerung wird erwartet • Erfahrung in nichtlinearen dynamischen Systemmethoden und datengesteuerter Analyse ist ein Plus Arbeitsplatz Wir bieten • Ihr Job mit Impact: Werden Sie Teil der ETH Zürich, die nicht nur Ihre berufliche Entwicklung unterstützt, sondern auch aktiv zum positiven Wandel in der Gesellschaft beiträgt • Sie können zahlreiche Vorteile erwarten, wie Saisontickets für den öffentlichen Nahverkehr und Carsharing, eine breite Palette von Sportangeboten des ASVZ, Kinderbetreuung und attraktive Pensionsleistungen. chevron right Arbeiten, Lehren und Forschen an der ETH Zürich Wir legen Wert auf Vielfalt und Nachhaltigkeit Im Einklang mit unseren Werten fördert die ETH Zürich eine inklusive Kultur. Wir fördern Chancengleichheit, schätzen Vielfalt und fördern ein Arbeits- und Lernumfeld, in dem die Rechte und die Würde aller unserer Mitarbeiter und Studenten respektiert werden. Besuchen Sie unsere Website für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt, um herauszufinden, wie wir ein faires und offenes Umfeld gewährleisten, in dem jeder wachsen und gedeihen kann. Nachhaltigkeit ist für uns ein zentraler Wert – wir arbeiten konsequent auf eine klimaneutrale Zukunft hin. Neugierig? Wir sind es auch. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung mit folgenden Unterlagen: • A CV • Bachelor- und Master-Transkripte • Kontaktinformationen von mindestens zwei Referenzen Weitere Informationen zur Gruppe finden Sie auf der Website des Chair of Nonlinear Dynamics . Fragen zur Stelle richten Sie bitte an Prof. George Haller, georgehaller@ethz.ch (keine Bewerbungen). Bitte beachten Sie, dass wir ausschließlich Bewerbungen annehmen, die über unser Online-Bewerbungsportal eingereicht werden. Bewerbungen per E-Mail oder Post werden nicht berücksichtigt. Über die ETH Zürich Die ETH Zürich ist eine der weltweit führenden Universitäten, die sich auf Wissenschaft und Technologie. Wir sind bekannt für unsere hervorragende Ausbildung, Spitzenforschung und direkter Wissenstransfer in die Gesellschaft. Über 30.000 Menschen aus mehr als 120 Ländern finden unsere Universität ein Ort zu sein, der unabhängiges Denken und eine Umwelt, die Exzellenz inspiriert. descriptionByLocale.fr: Poste de doctorat en modélisation et contrôle des systèmes dynamiques non linéaires à partir de données 100%, Zurich, durée déterminée imprimer Drucken La Chaire en dynamique non linéaire de l'ETH Zürich invite les candidats à un doctorat de 100 % dans le développement et l'application de méthodes de systèmes dynamiques non linéaires pour des problèmes physiques complexes connus uniquement à partir de données. jobs.description:
Scientific Assistant

50%, Zurich, fixed-term

print
Drucken

D-ARCH is a leading research and teaching institution dedicated to the advancement of architectural design at the building, urban, landscape and territorial scales. Architectural design is fundamentally holistic in that it utilises a broad epistemological and technical apparatus to give shape to cultural, ecological, environmental, social and economic needs. And, by constitution, architectural design is concerned both with the analysis of the past and the making of the future at every scale, from the local to the global.

The position is at UCJ Share of Architecture and Attitude, Prof. Jan De Vylder. It is a fixed-term contract (one year, renewable) starting in mid-August or September 2026. The workload is 50%, with work primarily on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, plus a few additional hours on other weekdays.

Job description

• Contribute with your technical and architectural expertise

• Prepare and process teaching and research materials

• Assist with and be part of the chair's projects

• Work independently on side projects led by the chair (eg. publications, symposium organization, seminarweek..)

• Introduce exercises, support and guide students as they develop their projects

Profile

• Architect with 2 + years of experience

• Structured, reliable and able to work independently within a small team

• Good communication skills in English and German

• Preferably running or starting your own practice

Workplace

Workplace

We offer

• Your job with impact: Become part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development, but also actively contributes to positive change in society

• You can expect numerous benefits , such as public transport season tickets and car sharing, a wide range of sports offered by the ASVZ , childcare and attractive pension benefits

chevron_right
Working, teaching and research at ETH Zurich

We value diversity and sustainability

In line with our values , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future .

Curious? So are we.

We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents until 13 July 2026:

• CV (1 page)

• Cover letter (1 page)

• Portfolio (3 projects that describe you best. Please include your project, if you have studied with our Chair)

Further information about the Department and the Institute can be found on our website . Questions regarding the position should be directed to baucjteam@ethz.ch.

Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

About ETH Zürich

ETH Zurich is one of the world’s leading universities specialising in
science and technology. We are renowned for our excellent education,
cutting-edge fundamental research and direct transfer of new knowledge
into society. Over 30,000 people from more than 120 countries find our
university to be a place that promotes independent thinking and an
environment that inspires excellence. Located in the heart of Europe,
yet forging connections all over the world, we work together to
develop solutions for the global challenges of today and tomorrow.

descriptionByLocale.it: Assistente scientifico 50%, Zurigo, a tempo determinato stampa Druppo D-ARCH è un istituto di ricerca e di insegnamento leader dedicato all'avanzamento del design architettonico nelle scale edili, urbane, paesaggistiche e territoriali. Il design architettonico è fondamentalmente olistico in quanto utilizza un ampio apparato epistemologico e tecnico per dare forma alle esigenze culturali, ecologiche, ambientali, sociali ed economiche. E, per costituzione, il design architettonico si occupa sia dell'analisi del passato che della realizzazione del futuro a ogni scala, dal locale al globale. La posizione è a UCJ Share of Architecture and Attitude, Prof. Jan De Vylder. Si tratta di un contratto a tempo determinato (un anno, rinnovabile) a partire da metà agosto o settembre 2026. Il carico di lavoro è del 50%, con il lavoro principalmente il martedì e il mercoledì, più alcune ore aggiuntive in altri giorni della settimana. Descrizione del lavoro • Contribuisci con le tue competenze tecniche e architettoniche • Preparare e elaborare materiali didattici e di ricerca • Assistere e far parte dei progetti della sedia • Lavorare indipendentemente dai progetti collaterali guidati dalla sedia (ad esempio pubblicazioni, organizzazione del simposio, settimana del seminario..) • Introdurre esercizi, supporto e guidare gli studenti mentre sviluppano i loro progetti Profilo • Architetto con 2 + anni di esperienza • Strutturato, affidabile e in grado di lavorare in modo indipendente all'interno di un piccolo team • Buone capacità di comunicazione in inglese e tedesco • Preferibilmente correre o iniziare la propria pratica Luogo di lavoro Offriamo • Il tuo lavoro con impatto: Diventa parte dell'ETH di Zurigo, che non solo supporta lo sviluppo professionale, ma contribuisce attivamente al cambiamento positivo nella società • È possibile aspettarsi numerosi vantaggi, come i biglietti per la stagione dei trasporti pubblici e la condivisione delle auto, una vasta gamma di sport offerti dalla ASVZ , l'assistenza all'infanzia e le interessanti prestazioni pensionistiche chevron right Lavoro, insegnamento e ricerca presso l'ETH di Zurigo Apprezziamo la diversità e la sostenibilità In linea con i nostri valori, ETH Zurich incoraggia una cultura inclusiva. Promuoviamo l'uguaglianza di opportunità, la diversità di valore e nutrire un ambiente di lavoro e di apprendimento in cui i diritti e la dignità di tutto il nostro staff e gli studenti sono rispettati. Visita il nostro sito Equal Opportunities and Diversity per scoprire come garantiamo un ambiente equo e aperto che permetta a tutti di crescere e fiorire. La sostenibilità è un valore fondamentale per noi – stiamo costantemente lavorando verso un futuro neutro dal clima. Curioso? Anche noi. Saremo lieti di ricevere la vostra domanda online con i seguenti documenti fino al 13 luglio 2026: • CV (1 pagina) • Lettera di copertura (1 pagina) • Portfolio (3 progetti che ti descrivono meglio. Si prega di includere il vostro progetto, se avete studiato con la nostra sedia) Ulteriori informazioni sul Dipartimento e l'Istituto possono essere trovate sul nostro sito web . Le domande relative alla posizione devono essere indirizzate a baucjteam@ethz.ch. Si prega di notare che accettiamo esclusivamente le applicazioni inviate tramite il nostro portale di applicazioni online. Le applicazioni via e-mail o servizi postali non saranno considerate. Vorremmo sottolineare che la pre-selezione è effettuata dai reclutatori responsabili e non dall'intelligenza artificiale. Informazioni su ETH Zürich ETH Zurich è una delle università più importanti del mondo specializzata in scienza e tecnologia. Siamo rinomati per la nostra eccellente educazione, ricerca fondamentale all'avanguardia e trasferimento diretto di nuove conoscenze nella società. Oltre 30.000 persone provenienti da più di 120 paesi università per essere un luogo che promuove il pensiero indipendente e un ambiente che ispira eccellenza. Situato nel cuore dell'Europa, ancora forgiando connessioni in tutto il mondo, lavoriamo insieme a sviluppare soluzioni per le sfide globali di oggi e domani.

Leiter:Leiterin Forschung und Forschungsunterstützung bei AgroVet-Strickhof (m/w/d)

80%-100%, Zürich, befristet

print
Drucken

Die ETH Zürich ist eine der weltweit führenden Universitäten für Naturwissenschaften und Technik. Das Institut für Agrarwissenschaften ( https://www.ias.ethz.ch ) im Departement für Umweltsystemwissenschaften (D-USYS) setzt sich mit Tierhaltung, Pflanzenwissenschaften und Ökonomie im globalen und schweizerischen Kontext der Landwirtschaft auseinander und betreibt relevante grundlagen- und anwendungsorientierte Forschung. Gemeisam mit ihren Partnern betreibt die ETH Zürich die Kooperation AgroVet-Strickhof , wo die universitäre Bildung und Forschung im Bereich der Agrar- und Veterinärwissenschaften mit den praktischen Bedürfnissen der Landwirtschaft verknüpft wird.

Projekthintergrund

Für AgroVet-Strickhof ( www.agrovet-strickhof.ch ) in Eschikon, Lindau bei Zürich, suchen wir einen Leiter / eine Leiterin für den Bereich Forschung und Forschungsunterstützung. AgroVet-Strickhof ist eine Gemeinschaftseinrichtung der ETH Zürich, des Kompetenzzentrums für Land- und Ernährungswirtschaft Strickhof und der Universität Zürich. AgroVet-Strickhof ermöglicht experimentelle und anwendungsorientierte Forschung, universitäre sowie praxisorientierte Aus- und Weiterbildung an landwirtschaftlichen Nutztieren sowie Wissenstransfer.

Diese Stelle ist ab 01.01.2027 oder nach Vereinbarung zu besetzen. Sie ist zunächst auf 12 Monate befristet; bei positiver Beurteilung während dieser Zeit erfolgt die Überführung in eine unbefristete Anstellung.

Stellenbeschreibung

• Ihre Hauptaufgabe besteht in der operativen Leitung und Koordination der Forschungsaktivitäten bei AgroVet-Strickhof im Auftrag der Geschäftsleitung sowie in der Unterstützung von Forschenden bei der Erstellung von Forschungskonzepten und der Durchführung von Forschungsprojekten.

• Sie sind verantwortlich für die Forschungseinrichtungen und übernehmen die Koordination zwischen den Forschenden und der Leitung des Ausbildungs- und Versuchsbetriebs des Strickhof.

• Sie führen Ihnen direkt unterstellte Mitarbeitende. Das Controlling des Budgets und die Budgetplanung für das Team Forschung und Forschungsunterstützung gehören ebenfalls zu Ihrem Aufgabenbereich.

Profil

• Sie haben einen Hochschulabschluss (oder Promotion) in Agrar- oder Veterinärwissenschaften.

• Sie begeistern sich für wissenschaftliches Arbeiten in einem internationalen und interdisziplinären Umfeld.

• Sie sind vertraut mit der landwirtschaftlichen Forschung und Praxis.

• Sie sind vertraut im Umgang mit landwirtschaftlichen Nutztieren.

• Sie arbeiten mit Eigeninitiative lösungsorientiert, zuverlässig und verantwortungsbewusst.

• Sie haben sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Arbeitsort

Arbeitsort

• Ein Beruf mit Wirkung: Werden Sie Teil der ETH Zürich, die nicht nur Ihre berufliche Entwicklung unterstützt, sondern auch aktiv zu positiven Veränderungen in der Gesellschaft beiträgt.

• Wir engagieren uns für eine nachhaltige und klimaneutrale Hochschule.

Im Einklang mit unseren Werten unterstützt die ETH Zürich eine inklusive Kultur. descriptionByLocale.en: Head of Research and Research Support at AgroVet-Strickhof (m/f/d) 80%-100%, Zurich, temporary Printed Printing ETH Zurich is one of the world's leading universities for natural sciences and technology. The Institute of Agricultural Sciences (hts://www.ias.ethz.ch ) in the Department of Environmental Systems Sciences (D-USYS) deals with animal husbandry, plant sciences and economics in the global and Swiss context of agriculture and carries out relevant basic and application-oriented research. Together with its partners, ETH Zurich operates the AgroVet-Strickhof cooperation, where university education and research in the field of agricultural and veterinary sciences are combined with the practical needs of agriculture. Project background For AgroVet-Strickhof (www.agrovet-strickhof.ch) in Eschikon, Lindau near Zurich, we are looking for a manager for research and research support. AgroVet-Strickhof is a joint institution of ETH Zurich, the Competence Center for Agriculture and Food Management Strickhof and the University of Zurich. AgroVet-Strickhof enables experimental and application-oriented research, university and practice-oriented education and training on agricultural livestock as well as knowledge transfer. This position is to be filled from 01.01.2027 or by agreement. It shall be limited to an initial period of 12 months; in the event of a positive assessment during this period, the transfer to permanent employment shall take place. Job description • Her main task is the operational management and coordination of the research activities at AgroVet-Strickhof on behalf of the management as well as the support of researchers in the preparation of research concepts and the implementation of research projects. • They are responsible for the research institutions and take over the coordination between the researchers and the management of the training and experimental operation of the Strickhof. • They lead you directly subordinate employees. Controlling the budget and budget planning for the research and research support team are also part of your remit. Profile • You have a university degree (or doctorate) in agricultural or veterinary sciences. • They are enthusiastic about scientific work in an international and interdisciplinary environment. • They are familiar with agricultural research and practice. • They are familiar with farm animals. • You work with your own initiative solution-oriented, reliable and responsible. • They have very good knowledge of German and English. Place of work We offer • Working in a research-oriented environment. • Become part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development, but also actively contributes to positive changes in society. • We are committed to a sustainable and climate-neutral university. • You can expect numerous perks, such as ÖV subscriptions and car sharing, a wide range of sports from the ASVZ, child care and attractive pension services. chevron right Working, teaching and researching at ETH Zurich Diversity and sustainability are important to us In line with our values, ETH Zurich supports an inclusive culture. jobs.description:
Group Lead Advanced Mechatronic Systems

90%-100%, Zurich, fixed-term

print
Drucken

The Department of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering (D‑ITET) at ETH Zürich is renowned for its world-class research and teaching ranging from integrated circuits to computer networks, from wireless communications to signal processing, and from control theory to electric energy. It offers a highly interdisciplinary research environment with strong expertise in power electronic components and converters, electric drives, electrical insulation, and system modeling.

Project background

The research of the Advanced Mechatronic Systems (AMS) group focuses on integrated mechatronic systems, including electromagnetic actuators, sensing, electrical machines, control, system-level integration, and related areas.

Job description

The AMS Group Lead is responsible for developing and leading an independent research activity in advanced mechatronic systems within D‑ITET. The role focuses on strengthening competencies in mechatronics, electromagnetic actuators, electrical machines, sensing, and system-level integration, complementing the department's strong expertise in power electronics.

In this role, you will:

• Develop and execute a research agenda focused on integrated mechatronic systems, electromagnetic actuators and electric motors

• Contribute to teaching in form of lectures and projects, supervision of student theses, and departmental initiatives

• Acquire and manage research funding across public and industrial sources

• Recruit and supervise PhD students and researchers, building a sustainable group structure

The role includes responsibility for initiating and developing research activities, with the scope of leadership responsibilities increasing according to the candidate’s level of seniority. We are looking for a candidate who:

• Takes responsibility for developing research and teaching activities at different levels of maturity and shows strong initiative and a self-driven approach to shaping research directions and collaborations

• Demonstrates leadership potential, including the ability to guide and support junior researchers

• Works collaboratively across disciplines (e.g., systems, control, electronics, mechanics)

• Communicates clearly in academic and industrial environment

Profile

The position is open to candidates at different levels of seniority, ranging from advanced postdoctoral researchers to experienced professionals from academia or industry.

You should have:

• A PhD in electrical or mechanical engineering with a focus on mechatronics or a closely related field

• Strong background in mechatronic systems, electromagnetic actuators, sensing, electrical machines, control of drive systems, or related areas

• Demonstrated ability or strong potential for developing independent research directions

• Track record or clear potential for funding acquisition and project execution

• Experience in teaching on university level and in mentoring students or junior researchers is beneficial

• Experience, or a strong interest in, leading people, fostering collaboration, and enabling professional and personal growth

Workplace

Workplace

We offer

ETH Zürich offers a stimulating international research environment with excellent infrastructure and strong academic and industrial connections.

The AMS Group Lead operates with a high degree of autonomy in defining research directions and building a project portfolio. The position is institutionally attached to D-ITET via an advisory board, which provides strategic guidance and oversight.

The position is initially offered for a fixed-term duration, with the opportunity of transitioning into a permanent position. The initial duration depends on the candidate’s level of maturity and performance. descriptionByLocale.it: Gruppo Lead Sistemi Mechatronic avanzati 90%-100%, Zurigo, a tempo determinato stampa Druppo Il Dipartimento di Tecnologia dell'Informazione e Ingegneria Elettrica (D‐ITET) di ETH Zürich è noto per la sua ricerca e insegnamento di livello mondiale che vanno dai circuiti integrati alle reti informatiche, dalle comunicazioni wireless all'elaborazione dei segnali, e dalla teoria del controllo all'energia elettrica. Offre un ambiente di ricerca altamente interdisciplinare con una forte competenza in componenti elettronici di potenza e convertitori, azionamenti elettrici, isolamento elettrico e modellazione di sistema. Sfondo del progetto La ricerca del gruppo Advanced Mechatronic Systems (AMS) si concentra su sistemi meccatronici integrati, tra cui attuatori elettromagnetici, rilevamento, macchine elettriche, controllo, integrazione a livello di sistema e aree correlate. Descrizione del lavoro Il Gruppo AMS Lead è responsabile dello sviluppo e della guida di un'attività di ricerca indipendente nei sistemi meccatronici avanzati all'interno di D‐ITET. Il ruolo si concentra sul rafforzamento delle competenze in meccatronica, attuatori elettromagnetici, macchine elettriche, rilevamento e integrazione a livello di sistema, completando la forte competenza del dipartimento nell'elettronica di potenza. In questo ruolo, voi: • Sviluppare ed eseguire un'agenda di ricerca focalizzata su sistemi meccatronici integrati, attuatori elettromagnetici e motori elettrici • Contribuire all'insegnamento in forma di conferenze e progetti, supervisione di tesi di studio e iniziative dipartimentali • Acquisire e gestire fondi di ricerca su fonti pubbliche e industriali • Recluta e supervisiona studenti e ricercatori del dottorato, costruendo una struttura di gruppo sostenibile Il ruolo include la responsabilità di avviare e sviluppare attività di ricerca, con la portata delle responsabilità di leadership che aumentano secondo il livello di seniority del candidato. Stiamo cercando un candidato che: • Si assume la responsabilità di sviluppare attività di ricerca e di insegnamento a diversi livelli di maturità e mostra una forte iniziativa e un approccio auto-guidato per modellare direzioni di ricerca e collaborazioni • Dimostra il potenziale di leadership, tra cui la capacità di guidare e sostenere i ricercatori junior • Opere collaborative attraverso discipline (ad esempio, sistemi, controllo, elettronica, meccanica) • Comunica chiaramente in ambiente accademico e industriale Profilo La posizione è aperta ai candidati a diversi livelli di anzianità, che vanno dai ricercatori postdoctoral avanzati ai professionisti esperti di accademia o industria. Avresti dovuto: • Un dottorato in ingegneria elettrica o meccanica con un focus sulla meccatronica o un campo strettamente correlato • Forte sfondo in sistemi meccatronici, attuatori elettromagnetici, rilevamento, macchine elettriche, controllo dei sistemi di azionamento, o aree correlate • Capacità dimostrata o forte potenziale per lo sviluppo di direzioni di ricerca indipendenti • Tracciare il record o il chiaro potenziale di finanziamento dell'acquisizione e dell'esecuzione del progetto • L'esperienza nell'insegnamento a livello universitario e nel mentoring studenti o giovani ricercatori è vantaggioso • Esperienza, o un forte interesse per, persone leader, promuovere la collaborazione, e consentire la crescita professionale e personale Luogo di lavoro Offriamo ETH Zürich offre un ambiente di ricerca internazionale stimolante con eccellenti infrastrutture e forti connessioni accademiche e industriali. Il Gruppo AMS Lead opera con un alto grado di autonomia nella definizione delle direzioni di ricerca e nella realizzazione di un portafoglio di progetti. La posizione è istituzionalizzata a D-ITET tramite un consiglio consultivo, che fornisce orientamento strategico e supervisione. La posizione è inizialmente offerta per una durata a tempo determinato, con l'opportunità di passare in una posizione permanente. La durata iniziale dipende dal livello di maturità e prestazioni del candidato. Si prevede una forte interazione con partner interni ed esterni, con prestazioni valutate attraverso la produzione scientifica, il successo dei finanziamenti e contributi

jobs.description:
Research Assistant in Quantitative Online Discourse Research

10%-30%, Zurich, fixed-term

print
Drucken

The Public Policy Group at ETH Zurich and the Public Discourse Foundation invite applications for a research assistant position starting as soon as possible and lasting one year, with the possibility of renewal.

Project background

You will be part of a collaborative team committed to rigorous research on how to improve public discourse on social and online media and other digital platforms. We study the effects of platforms’ policies and work with them to design and test interventions to improve the quality of online discussions and reduce harm caused by hate speech. To do so, we combine data from social media, online newspapers and original surveys with causal inference and machine learning methods to bring new evidence to bear on the urgent problems policymakers and practitioners face. We collaborate with a nonprofit dedicated to tackling hate speech, the Public Discourse Foundation , and various newspapers to translate our research into impact.

Job description

• We are looking for a research assistant (with a workload of 20%) to join our ongoing research program on online discourse and how to improve it

• The primary responsibility lies with our data pipeline, which requires the review of any failed tests on our weekly data imports, as well as general maintenance and improvement of the code- and database

• This will take the form of responding to issues on GitHub, debugging issues in our R and Python scripts, creating pull requests, writing documentation, and collaboratively developing new features

• You will also analyse our data on online comments searching for interesting patterns or unexpected changes

• The general research program aims to understand online discourse, with a particular focus on the DACH region, and design and implement interventions to improve discourse and reduce hate speech

• We work together with online newspapers and use social media data

• Our research employs advanced statistical methods for causal inference and we develop state-of-the-art machine learning classifiers for both harmful and high-quality speech

• The position is located in the team of Dominik Hangartner at ETH Zurich, but you will also have the opportunity to work with an array of affiliated faculty as well as with the Public Discourse Foundation

Profile

Strong candidates will have most of the following:

• Completed undergraduate degree in a social science program with a preference for Political Science, Economics, Sociology, Data Science, Computational Social Science, or in a closely related discipline

• Knowledge of causal inference methods and/or machine learning

• Strong command of R (required) and/or Python (desirable)

• Familiarity with GitHub and collaborative work on GitHub

• Experience with Docker, SQL, and automated data pipelines desirable

• Ability to collaborate effectively with project team members and external stakeholders alike

• Proficiency and excellent writing skills in English; at least B1 German; basic French is an asset

• Knowledge of or interest in social media platforms and content moderation policies

• Interest in the societal applications of research

Workplace

Workplace

We offer

• Highly collaborative work environment within a very motivated and supportive team

• Opportunity to develop a network with academics and practitioners

• Career mentoring by experienced researchers

• Salary in accordance with ETH guidelines

• Possibility to work remotely with flexible work hours (~10h/week, subject to fluctuating demand)

chevron_right
Working, teaching and research at ETH Zurich

We value diversity and sustainability

In line with our values , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal O

Nous collaborons avec un organisme sans but lucratif voué à la lutte contre les discours haineux, la Fondation des discours publics et divers journaux pour traduire nos recherches en impact.
